name: Alley
look: A narrow alley in the rain. The storm has broken, and it smells of garbage learning to swim. Fire escapes zig-zag up the brick. The ladder is pulled up, out of reach. A rusted car sits on its rims. Across the way a black door waits under a purple neon PURPLE RHINO sign, guarded by a bouncer the size of a vending machine. A hooked umbrella leans by the trash. A man sits on a flattened box.

hotspots.look: The back door of the Rusty Nail. It still smells like beer, which is an improvement.
Garbage. Just garbage. The umbrella leaning on it is the only thing with ambition.
An old black umbrella with a hooked handle. Somebody left in a hurry. The rain stayed.
A soggy matchbook sits in a puddle by the Purple Rhino door.
It has a lid and a point of view. You leave both alone.
The Purple Rhino. Members, and guests who smell better than a subway platform.
Purple neon. PURPLE RHINO. It hisses in the rain.
The ladder's pulled up, a good two feet out of reach, even from the dumpster.
A '78 Buick that has been here since '78. The rain is not improving it.
Flattened cardboard, recently occupied by a man who notices things.
A man on a flattened box, watching the rain like it owes him an explanation.
A bouncer the size of a vending machine. The purple door does not open itself.
